name: Unauthorized Access Response Playbook
description: Containment procedure for unauthorized access attempt on SCADA infrastructure

actions.description: Block attacker's source IP at perimeter and internal firewalls immediately
Disable the compromised user account and revoke all active sessions
Revoke all API tokens and session tokens associated with compromised account
Archive all access logs from the compromised session for forensic investigation
Alert security team with attacker IP, account affected, and timeline of access

recovery_steps: Audit all actions taken by compromised account during breach window
Reset passwords for affected account and all accounts with similar access
Review and tighten access control policies for SCADA systems
Enable MFA if not already present on all privileged accounts
Conduct threat hunt for lateral movement from compromised account
